text:
mia: Heads-up — I found a couple of broken links and an old SDK snippet in the Optimize toolkit docs while doing the sample sweep. The obsidian export changed some relative paths. Can we coordinate a small migration PR?
sam: Thanks for flagging. Which pages? can you paste the links?
mia: /optimize/batching.md (link to /examples/old-sdk/kv-prefetch.md) and /optimize/quant-profiles.md (example uses `redwood.optimize.BatchClient` from v1).
kai: I can take batching.md link fixes. Is the plan to replace old-sdk examples with v2 snippets or add a migration note?
mia: Prefer swap to v2 snippets + small migration note. The v2 snippet also demonstrates `prefetch_window` which is a new recommended knob.
ashley: I can update quant-profiles.md to mention the short-seq fallback heuristic — but I need the exact v2 code to paste. Sam, do you have the canonical v2 sample?
sam: Yep — here's the minimal v2 example we want to land (copy/paste):
```python
from redwood import OptimizeClient
client = OptimizeClient()
profile = {
  "name": "shortseq-fallback",
  "heuristics": {"short_seq_threshold": 64, "fallback_model": "redwood/small-compat"}
}
client.apply_quant_profile(profile)
```
kai: Nice. For batching.md I hit one weird case where obsidian prefixed asset links with `/assets/obsidian/...` which breaks the static site. I'll rewrite links to the canonical `/static/examples/...` path.
ashley: For the quant doc, two small copy edits: explain why short_seq_threshold matters (examples: chat vs. single-token queries) and call out metric regression risk when pairing aggressive quant and batching.
mia: Agreed. Also we should add a short example showing how `prefetch_window` interacts with `kv_cache`: recommend `prefetch_window=8` for high-variance prompt lengths. That was a frequent question in support.
sam: Good call. I can craft a tiny snippet and run the docs CI smoke to ensure formatting:
```py
# prefetch + kv cache snippet
from redwood import OptimizeClient
oc = OptimizeClient()
oc.optimize_route("/generate", prefetch_window=8, kv_cache=True)
```
opsbot: docs-ci triggered: lint/links check queued (job #4623).
mi a: (typo alert) I meant "mia" not "mi a" — ignore opsbot.
kai: Will open PR for batching link fixes: #7892. PR description will say: "fix obsidian-export paths -> static examples; update example path and add redirect".
sam: I'll open PR for code snippets + migration notes: #7893. Includes v2 examples, small rationale paragraphs, and the prefetch snippet.
ashley: I'll put grammar + risk notes on #7893 as a PR review request. Also will add a tiny eval note about regression monitoring: recommend adding a prompt-set and compare token-level perplexity after quant changes.
mia: Can someone add a to-do checklist in the PR templates? I want: verify link targets, run docs-ci, smoke-check snippet execution, add migration blurb.
kai: Added checklist to #7892.
sam: Added checklist to #7893 and kicked off a local mkdocs build to confirm code fences render.
opsbot: PR #7892 opened by kai: https://github.com/redwood/infra-docs/pull/7892 — status: draft.
opsbot: PR #7893 opened by sam: https://github.com/redwood/infra-docs/pull/7893 — status: draft.
mia: Quick QA plan: kai validates all /static/examples links 1x, sam runs snippet runs against a small local container (use model redwood/small-compat), ashley writes the migration blurb, I will run docs smoke CI after merges.
ashley: One more content suggestion: add a short table that maps old v1 classes -> v2 equivalents (e.g., `BatchClient` -> `OptimizeClient.optimize_route`) — that'll help customers migrating.
sam: Good idea. I'll add a tiny table in migration note.
kai: I found an extra place using `kv_prefetch` snake_case var in an example. Will normalize to `kv_prefetch_enabled` so naming is consistent with SDK.
mia: Perfect. Timeline? can we land before the weekly release snapshot (Tues)?
sam: I can get #7893 ready for review by EOD Mon. kai aiming for same. ashley will review Tue morning.
opsbot: docs-ci: lint/links passed for PR #7893, but mkdocs build failed on #7892 due to a missing asset (job #4626).
kai: I'll patch the asset path on #7892 now.
ashley: When we merge, please add a short changelog entry under docs/CHANGELOG.md referencing the migration help and the prefetched knob guidance.
mia: Thanks everyone. If anything blocks, @here ping me. I'll do a final sweep after merges. :rocket:
